Vocabulary version 1.

Concept types:
- person: Someone in the owner's life, as the owner sees them. The owner is also a Person, flagged is_self. Fields: relationship_to_owner, is_self.
- group: A set of people: a family, an employer, a friend circle. Kind (optional): family, employer, friend_circle, other.
- situation: An ongoing circumstance that could change or end. Fields: start, end.
- event: One dated occasion, past or planned. Fields: when, precision, occurrence.
- feeling: An emotion.
- sensation: A bodily sensation. Fields: body_area.
- belief: A standing conviction about oneself, a person or the world. Judgements of people are Beliefs.
- behaviour: Something a person does. Kind (optional): coping_tool.
- need: What a feeling or behaviour seeks or protects.
- value: What matters to a person.
- goal: Something being worked towards. Fields: progress.
- trait: A lasting characteristic of a person. Kind (required): strength, diagnosis, physical, other.
- role: A role or identity a person holds.

Relationship types (from -> to):
- LED_TO: any type -> feeling, sensation, belief, behaviour, event. One thing came right before, or brought on, another. Records the Event it happened in when known.
- OCCURRED_IN: feeling, sensation, belief, behaviour -> event. It showed up during that event. Carries its order in the event.
- ABOUT: feeling, belief, need, goal -> person, group, situation, event, trait, role. What it concerns. A belief about oneself points at the owner's Person node.
- CAME_FROM: belief, value, behaviour, need, trait -> event, person, group, situation. Where it originated.
- HOLDS: person -> belief, value, goal, role. That person holds it.
- HAS: person -> trait, need. That person has it.
- BELONGS_TO: person -> group. Membership.
- INVOLVES: event, situation -> person, group. Who was part of it.
- PART_OF: event, role -> situation, group. An event inside a situation, or a role inside a group or situation.
- SERVES: behaviour, feeling, belief -> need. It exists to meet that need.
- HELPS: behaviour, trait, person, situation, belief -> goal, need, feeling, situation. It makes the target easier. Coping tools use this.
- BLOCKS: behaviour, trait, person, situation, belief -> goal, need, value. It gets in the way.
- CONFLICTS_WITH: belief, value, need, goal, behaviour, role -> belief, value, need, goal, behaviour, role. The two pull against each other.

Life areas: love, family, friendships, work, body_health, self.
